CustomField.description: Which of the roster's files the run processed: Provider (Providers, ProviderIntakeService) or Relationships (Provider-facility relationships, RelationshipIntakeService). Picks the row processor (RosterIntakeRunService.processorFor), filters the two run lists and control panels on the roster page, and splits the roster's roll-ups (Provider Runs / Relationship Runs).
